name: SIQ - Mix & Match Pack
description: Bento-style product grid with mix-and-match bundle builder. Customers browse a masonry product grid and add items to a floating bundle bar. Features smooth parallax scroll effects on desktop (cards shift subtly as you scroll), animated mesh gradient or solid background, configurable columns/gaps/image-ratio/overlay-opacity, and a clean static 2-column grid on mobile. Perfect for bundles, gift sets, or curated product packs.
author: SectionIQ
